description: This file contains HTTP handlers for managing vector embeddings, including creating, retrieving, deleting, and searching vectors within a storage backend. It includes request types, handler functions, and route logic using the Gin framework.

methods.name: SetVectorHandler
methods.description: Handles storing or updating a vector embedding in storage.

methods.name: GetVectorHandler
methods.description: Retrieves a vector record by key, considering scope.

methods.name: DeleteVectorHandler
methods.description: Deletes a vector record by key.

methods.name: DeleteNamespaceVectorsHandler
methods.description: Deletes all vectors matching the specified namespace prefix.

methods.name: SimilaritySearchHandler
methods.description: Performs a similarity search query against stored vectors.
